sun.awt

类 AWTAccessor

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.awt.AWTAccessor

  • public final class AWTAccessor
extends Object
    The AWTAccessor utility class. The main purpose of this class is to enable accessing private and package-private fields of classes from different classes/packages. See sun.misc.SharedSecretes for another example.
